title_zh: 缩小编程社团合作试办并先核对人手

scenario.label_zh: 商定编程社团合作的小规模试办
scenario.goal_zh: 考虑志愿者不足的问题，决定向潜在合作机构提出单次入门活动并先确认导师安排

context_zh: 图书馆职员与志愿者讨论尚未确定的教育合作。
author: author-phase08-c

sentences.speaker: Mei
sentences.text: The college looks like a potential partner for our programming club.

sentences.speaker: Dylan
sentences.text: What would the partnership involve? We can't promise a weekly course yet.

sentences.speaker: Mei
sentences.text: That's partly why I want their help. We have computers, but only one volunteer who can teach coding.

sentences.speaker: Dylan
sentences.text: Let's suggest one beginner session first, with their tutor and our volunteer working together.

sentences.speaker: Mei
sentences.text: I'll ask whether a tutor is available before we offer a date to the public.

sentences.speaker: Dylan
sentences.text: Good. Once we know who's teaching, we can agree on the lesson and decide whether to continue.
